page.notes: Line 9 "sis" and line 26 "fis" are printed as long-s forms of the words "sis"/"fis"; read as printed. The "Sigmius" in line 19 is probably a printing error for Sigismundus; left as printed. The "Hugariae" in line 16 is doubtful (the first letter may be an umlaut-marked H or a printing flaw). Page numbers in the right margin are partly blurred, notably "3o9" and "401"; some digits are uncertain. Left and right entries are not always clearly separated, and the reading order follows the printed lines. The faint gathering signature at the foot is not legible and is omitted.
